name: Pantile
description: A clay pantile roof: rounded covers and hollow pans side by side, every course lapping over the one below, shaded so the rolls stand out.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { z-index: @calc(100 - @y); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 46%; top: 0; width: 54%; height: 121%; border-radius: 0 0 40% 40% / 0 0 12% 12%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color1) 0 21%, transparent 33%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 14%, var(--color1) 52%, transparent 90%), @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -6%; top: 0; width: 56%; height: 127%; border-radius: 0 0 50% 50% / 0 0 22% 22%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color1) 0 20%, transparent 31%), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color1) 0, transparent 32% 72%, var(--color1) 100%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 38%, var(--color5) 47%, transparent 56%), @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
